title: 第128章 共主第127章 治好邝楠黎
slug: 玄幻我有机甲鬼才愿意去修仙
content_zh:
“多谢前辈，等处理所有事情，晚辈一定信守承诺。”
绮梦检查家人，惊喜地发现竟有一位已经可以媲美化神初期修士的实力。
“不必了，现在情况如何？什么时候出发？”
“前辈，青狗宗来人了，晚辈......”
绮梦将她的计划一五一十说了清楚。
石泉水得知后没有任何意见，一个青狗宗而已，就算灭了，对仙问宫也没有任何损失。
“青狗宗内是否有圣器？”
“前辈，圣器谈不上，但有一件只有宗主才知道的宝物，晚辈只知道是名字，叫虫蝎骨。”
“虫蝎骨？这是一件骨头？”
“晚辈不知。”
石泉水迅速让杂货铺开始搜寻相关的记录，他隐约感知这件骨头有可能是件非常厉害的邪器。
“这位少内护法是否可拉拢？”
“此人倒是能拉拢，但他喜怒无常，乃是反复的小人，绝对不是可信之人。”
石泉水看向面前的尸傀，它无法开口，却能写。
“你按照你计划去做，这些尸傀足以杀了此人，你若遇到麻烦，我自会来寻你。明日日出前若无咬紧的事情不要来找我。”
他还惦记着储物戒内的邪物。
绮梦谢了一番这才快速退下。
石泉水踱步来到街上。
今天的天气诡异的很，哪怕艳阳当照，给人以一种置身于冰窟之内。
街上的百姓，还是修为低的，都身裹着厚厚的棉衣。

有些店铺内直接生起了炭火。
伙计连生意都不做了，猫着身体守着火盆。
“这天怎么如此冷？”
“道友，这是冰玄之期到了，每个几年就会开启，一次开启会维持一月左右。照着情况，明天就会正式开启，到时各宗和各个家族都会派修士过来。”
“可这天来的实在太莫名奇妙了。”
“每次差不多是这个月份。”
石泉水跟路人聊着，七巧收到消息寻了过来。
“师父。”
石泉水看到她来，立马迎了上去，“你怎么样？”
“吃了药暂时没事了，但总感觉身体有点乏。”
邬七巧紧了紧身上的狐裘，嘴唇已经冻得发紫。
石泉水抓住她的手仔细号脉，“你的情况不算糟糕，但这天气越来越冷，你的身体恐怕会越来越糟。走吧，先去客栈。七巧，你怎么知道我在这里？”
“是......是邝家的人，说他们是九里十八铺的人，又说师父是他们的主人。有师父消息，就先通知我。”
邬七巧跟了上去，身体不住地打颤。
石泉水拿出块火玉递给了她，“此物暂时能护住你，但再寒冷一些，恐怕不顶用。”
这里的寒气再寒冷一些，大部分修士只能缩在温暖的地方。
对百姓的威胁反而可能更小。
邬七巧握着火玉，一股股暖意从手指流入，慢慢流向全身。
“师父，好像寒气越来越重了。”
石泉水猛地回头抓走火玉。

火玉上结了薄薄一层冰霜，火玉的温度正快速下降。
content_en:
"Thank you, senior. Once everything is taken care of, I will keep my promise."
Qimeng checked her family and was pleasantly surprised to find that there was one person who could already match the strength of the monks in the early stages of becoming a god.
"No need, what's the situation now? When will we leave?"
"Senior, someone from the Qing Dog Sect is here, junior..."
Qimeng made her plan clear.
Shi Quanshui had no objection after learning about it. It was just a Qing Dog Sect. Even if it was destroyed, there would be no loss to Xianwen Palace.
"Is there any sacred weapon in the Qing Dog Sect?"
"Senior, I can't speak of a sacred artifact, but there is a treasure that only the sect master knows about. I only know its name, called Insect Scorpion Bone."
"Insect scorpion bone? Is this a bone?"
"Junior doesn't know."
Shi Quanshui quickly asked the grocery store to search for relevant records. He had a vague feeling that this bone might be a very powerful evil weapon.
"Can this young inner protector be winned over?"
"This person can be won over, but he is moody and repetitive. He is definitely not a trustworthy person."
Shi Quanshui looked at the corpse puppet in front of him. It couldn't speak, but it could write.
"You follow your plan. These corpse puppets are enough to kill this person. If you encounter trouble, I will come to find you. Don't come to me if you have nothing to stick to before sunrise tomorrow."
He was still thinking about the evil things in the storage ring.
Qimeng thanked her and quickly left.
Shi Quanshui walked to the street.
The weather today is very strange. Even though the sun is shining brightly, it gives people the feeling of being in an ice cave.
The people on the street are still of low cultivation, and they are all wrapped in thick cotton clothes.
Charcoal fires were lit directly in some shops.
The guy didn't even do business, he just stood guarding the brazier.
"Why is it so cold today?"
"Fellow Taoist, this is the period of Ice Xuan. It will be opened every few years, and it will last for about a month. Depending on the situation, it will be officially opened tomorrow, and then all sects and families will send monks here."
"But what happened today is so inexplicable and wonderful."
"It's almost this month every time."
Shi Quanshui was chatting with passers-by, and Qiqiao came looking after receiving the news.
"Master."
Shi Quanshui saw her coming and immediately went to greet her, "How are you?"
"I'm fine for the time being after taking medicine, but I always feel a little tired."
Wu Qiqiao tightened the fox fur around her body, and her lips were already purple from the cold.
Shi Quanshui grabbed her hand and checked her pulse carefully, "Your condition is not bad, but as the weather gets colder and colder, your health will probably get worse. Let's go to the inn first. Qiqiao, how did you know I'm here?"
"Yes... they are from the Kuang family. They said they are from Jiuli Shibapu, and that the master is their master. If you have any news about the master, please inform me first."
Wu Qiqiao followed, his body trembling.
Shi Quanshui took out a piece of fire jade and handed it to her, "This thing can protect you temporarily, but if it gets colder, I'm afraid it won't be effective."
The cold here is even colder, and most of the monks can only huddle in a warm place.
The threat to the people may actually be smaller.
Wu Qiqiao held the fire jade, and a stream of warmth flowed from his fingers and slowly spread throughout his body.
"Master, it seems that the cold is getting worse and worse."
Shi Quanshui suddenly turned around and grabbed Huo Yu.
There was a thin layer of frost on the fire jade, and the temperature of the fire jade was dropping rapidly.
